shots.say: You wake up made of bricks. One hundred of them.
You're in the Nether, in a hall of statues. Every statue was a hero who ran out of bricks.
One statue has a giant stone right hand, cracked loose at the shoulder. In Hellboy, that hand is the key that ends the world.
Take it and you gain four bricks. But the statue's eyes open, and something starts to watch you.
Leave it and the road still takes two bricks off you. Nothing in here is free.
A: take the hand. Or B: leave it. Comment A or B. Part 2 follows the vote.
